name: Drive Dedup
summary: Scans external drives for duplicates and plans a clean consolidation with checkpoints.
story: Old drives are archaeological sites. The goal is not just delete duplicates; it is recover the useful record without losing the weird valuable thing.

launcher.long: Scans an external drive for duplicates and consolidates everything into a clean folder structure. Runs in two phases: first it maps what's there, then it moves things around.
